primary_gt.proof: The point record passes all four tests: 116.6 km/h >= 90 km/h, 28.0 hPa >= 20 hPa, 120.3/165.3 = 0.728 >= 0.70, and the peak gust, minimum pressure, and wettest hour are within 1 hour. Because wind, pressure fall, and concentrated rainfall pass together, a wind-only or rain-only diagnosis is rejected.

event.event_name: Super Typhoon Yagi severe wind and rainfall impacts

decision_rule.summary: Pass only when the local point record satisfies damaging gust, pressure drop, rainfall concentration, and peak-timing coherence thresholds.

key_values.local_point_window_basis: Use the full package hourly point record for 2024-09-01 through 2024-09-07 inclusive; GDACS exact todate is not used to truncate the local point series.

criteria.name: JSON structure and conclusion
criteria.description: Returns the requested five-key JSON structure and the exact conclusion label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a mostly complete structure with a correct but misplaced conclusion.

criteria.name: Numeric ledger
criteria.description: Computes all requested values within tolerance: catalog wind, local gust, gust-energy proxy, pressure drop, total precipitation, wettest 24-hour precipitation, concentration ratio, and timing lag.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit by metric family when formulas are recognizable and units are preserved.

criteria.name: Formula use
criteria.description: Uses the specified rolling-sum, ratio, squared-gust, pressure-range, and time-lag formulas.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point per correctly applied formula family, up to 4.

criteria.name: Threshold proof
criteria.description: Applies the four inequalities correctly and recognizes that all four tests pass.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for mostly correct threshold logic with one missing or misclassified test.

criteria.name: Rejected alternative
criteria.description: Rejects a single wind or rain reading because wind, pressure fall, and concentrated rainfall pass together.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for rejecting a one-driver reading without tying it to the full calculation.

criteria.name: Computed interpretation
criteria.description: Gives a compact interpretation consistent with coupled typhoon passage forcing.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point for a correct but wordy interpretation.

criteria.name: Claim control
criteria.description: Avoids unjustified exact loss, outage, road-closure, or flood-depth claims.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point if such claims are clearly secondary and do not drive the answer.
